faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is the MoneFin app really 100% free?
faq.a1: Yes! MoneFin can be used 100% free with no hidden fees, no separate Pro version, and no limit on the number of transactions.
faq.q2: Is my financial data safe in MoneFin?
faq.a2: Your security and privacy is our top priority. We use industry-standard data encryption (HTTPS & Bearer Token) and never sell your financial data to third parties.
faq.q3: Can I lock the app so others can't open it?
faq.a3: Of course. MoneFin supports secure login authentication and email OTP code verification for double protection.
faq.q4: Can I export financial reports to Excel or PDF format?
faq.a4: Yes! You can export monthly financial report summaries directly from the Reports page in both PDF and Excel spreadsheet formats.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: At MoneFin, we deeply value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.
privacy_page.s1_desc: We collect information you provide directly when creating an account, such as your name, email address, and financial data you enter for recording transactions. We may also collect device data and activity logs for security purposes.
privacy_page.s2_desc: Your data is used solely to provide MoneFin's application features (such as portfolio calculations and expense analysis), improve our services, and protect account security from unauthorized access.
privacy_page.s3_desc: We implement multiple security measures, including industry-standard encryption and two-factor authentication (2FA), to keep your data safe from breaches or unlawful access. We never sell your data to third parties.
privacy_page.s4_desc: If you have any questions regarding our privacy policy, please contact our support team at

security_page.title: Security
security_page.subtitle: Our Top Priority
security_page.intro: At MoneFin, the security of your financial data is an absolute priority. We design our systems to the highest security standards so you can record and monitor your finances with peace of mind.
security_page.m1_desc: We provide two-step verification using OTP (One-Time Password) sent via email to prevent unauthorized access even if your password is compromised.
security_page.m2_desc: Sensitive data such as passwords are encrypted using industry standards (such as bcrypt) in our database. Data transmitted between your browser and our servers is protected with TLS/SSL (HTTPS) encryption.
security_page.m3_desc: You can monitor which devices and locations are currently connected to your account. You can also easily terminate (log out) sessions on other devices remotely.
security_page.m4_desc: All new accounts are required to complete email verification to prevent spam registrations and ensure critical notifications always reach you.
security_page.m5_desc: Your login session will automatically expire (JWT-based token) if there is no activity for a specified period, preventing unauthorized access if a device is left unattended.
security_page.best_practices_desc: While we work tirelessly to protect you, security also depends on you. Ensure you use a combination of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols for your password. Never share your password or OTP code with anyone, and avoid logging in on untrusted public devices.
